Entries.Text: The offset to add to the entry ID for each duplicate.
How many duplicates to create per entry.
With more than one duplicate, multiply the offset for each one (e.g. with an offset of 100, the first duplicate is ID + 100, the second ID + 200, and so on).
Skipped {0} duplicates whose new ID already exists (Allow Duplicate ID is off).
The offset must be a whole number.
